name: Napoleon Bonaparte
descriptor: Napoleon Bonaparte, clean-shaven man in his mid-thirties, lean face, strong jaw, straight nose, heavy dark brows, small grey-blue eyes, dark slightly wavy hair with a lock over the forehead, black bicorne hat worn side-on with a tricolour cockade and thin gold trim, dark navy general's coat with a high scarlet collar, red piping and gold buttons, gold fringed epaulettes, white waistcoat
negative: beard, moustache, old man, elderly, overweight, bald, modern clothing, crown, wrong uniform colours
consistency_plan: now: identical descriptor in every prompt + IP-Adapter style reference (whole approved image) + IP-Adapter Plus-Face reference (approved face crop, no InsightFace) + seed search; Claude rejects candidates whose face or uniform drifts
after about 20 approved Napoleon images: train an SDXL character LoRA locally (OneTrainer or kohya_ss, 8 GB settings) and list it in loras; keep the face adapter at a lower weight
history_note: The approved look is artistic (client reference). In 1805 Napoleon usually wore the green colonel's uniform of the Chasseurs a Cheval of the Guard, often under a grey greatcoat, with a plain bicorne.
